label: Week 7
method: search_news 24h max_results=10; get_posts_counts_recent 24h (day granularity, from 2026-10-24T01:06Z; total_tweet_count)

filter_note.note: Saturday of Week 7 (eve of Sunday slate incl. PIT-NO Paris). Loudest by count: DAL, ATL, CHI, PIT, BUF, SF, NE, DET, NO, SEA. ATL volume driven mostly by the throwback-logo meme (dropped). Cross-club items kept only where this club is a game participant or trade party (CIN via BAL Lamar out, HOU via MHJ and NYG outs, TEN via CLE, NO via PIT Paris, MIA/NYJ forecast). Dropped mostly college football (Miami-Pitt, Cincinnati-Texas Tech, Alabama, Tennessee-South Carolina, Michigan, Utah, Kentucky), NBA/NHL/F1/MLB/soccer (Knicks title, Flyers-Ducks, Hawks, Nuggets, Jets NHL, Austin GP, World Series), memes/stunts (Falcons logo, AI Trump/Falcons videos, 49ers fan tattoo, Bears fan chants, Patriots map banter, Bills-49ers fan clash), nostalgia (Hamlin 2023 game, Romo 2006 debut), politics ads, generic betting/OPOY markets, fan-uniform items (Steelers Paris uniforms), and many cross-club duplicates. MIN/WSH/LAC/TB/CAR had only suitor or passing mentions.

items.title: Marvin Harrison Jr. Talks Arizona Exit After Texans Trade
items.one_line: MHJ says QB uncertainty wore on him in Arizona; Ossenfort called the deal tough but necessary.

items.title: 49ers Visit Falcons in Possible Trap Game
items.one_line: 6-0 SF arrives thin at WR; chatter says lines are tightening toward Atlanta for Sunday 1 p.m. ET.

items.title: Lamar Jackson Out Again vs. Bengals
items.one_line: High ankle sprain sidelines Lamar a third straight game; Tyler Huntley starts, Tavius Robinson out for the season.

items.title: Josh Allen Leads QBs in Rushing TDs Since 2025
items.one_line: PFF chart has Allen at 22 rushing scores since last season, eight already in 2026.

items.title: Caleb Williams Leads Bears Past Patriots 30-24
items.one_line: Williams threw for 308 and two TDs; Santos hit a 58-yard FG to seal the TNF win and move to 5-2.

items.title: Herbstreit 'Bucking Bronco' Comment Draws Backlash
items.one_line: Herbstreit's TNF description of Williams' development was called racially coded by many viewers.

items.title: Caleb Williams Fined $11,941 for Caddix Cleats
items.one_line: League fined Williams for unauthorized cleats; Caddix offered to cover fines and he kept wearing them.

items.title: Bengals Draw Ravens Without Lamar
items.one_line: Baltimore rules Lamar out a third straight week, so Cincinnati faces Tyler Huntley Sunday.

items.title: Browns Activate Dylan Sampson, Clear Delpit
items.one_line: Sampson back from IR for Titans game; Teven Jenkins to IR (back); Delpit out of concussion protocol.

items.title: Deshaun Watson's McLaren Hometown Visit Splits Fans
items.one_line: Watson's car-show drive through his Gainesville neighborhood drew both criticism and defense.

items.title: Schottenheimer Defends His Play-Calling
items.one_line: At 2-4 he refused to give up calls and called out George Pickens' run blocking before MNF vs. PHI.

items.title: Cowboys Recognize Cheerleaders' Union
items.one_line: Team formally recognized the DCC Association as the squad's bargaining group.

items.title: Troy Aikman Open to Cowboys Front Office Role
items.one_line: Aikman says he'd seriously consider a job under Jerry Jones; no offer exists yet.

items.title: Broncos Activate Coleman and Cooper for Cardinals
items.one_line: Rookie RB Jonah Coleman off IR, Jonathon Cooper off exempt list; Badie and Elliss to IR.

items.title: Lions Activate Brian Branch and Cade Mays

items.title: Sam LaPorta Clears Air on Contract

items.title: Hutchinson's Players-Only Meeting Credited for Defensive Turnaround

items.title: Packers Activate Josh Jacobs for Lions Game

items.title: Matthew Golden Fined $11,941 for Flex
items.one_line: Golden's taunting flag in the Dallas win drew a fine amid the league's taunting crackdown.

items.title: Packers at Lions NFC North Showdown
items.one_line: 4-2 GB visits 3-2 DET Sunday 4:25 p.m. ET; Love vs. Goff with Detroit's 20-sack pass rush.

items.title: Marvin Harrison Jr. Settles In With Texans

items.title: Colts Field Trade Calls on Nelson, Buckner, Taylor

items.title: Jaguars Weighing Brian Thomas Jr. Trade

items.title: Bears Rookie's Effort on Stevenson TD Draws Probe Calls
